tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Generate a fresh Ed25519 wallet for an AI agent: returns the ICP principal and the PKCS#8 PEM private key. The private key is returned exactly once over this call and is never stored anywhere. No signup, no on-chain registration — the keypair IS the wallet.

tools.name: claim_faucet_grant
tools.description: Claim the one-time free 1T cycles grant from the FirstKey faucet for an agent principal. One claim per principal, ever. The grant lands on the cycles ledger and funds the agent's first canister deploy.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Deploy a static website for an agent: creates a canister on the Internet Computer, installs the FirstKey static host, uploads every file, and returns the live https URL. The agent is added as a controller of its site canister. One free deploy per agent principal, funded from the FirstKey deploy pool

tools.name: deploy_upload_chunk
tools.description: Upload one chunk of a large file to an already-deployed agent site (for files that don't fit in a single deploy_site call). Chunks are appended in order; set is_last on the final chunk to publish the file.

tools.name: check_cycles
tools.description: Read an ICP principal's cycles balance on the cycles ledger.

tools.name: get_fuel_link
tools.description: Get the FirstKey Fuel payment link for a principal: a human pays by card (Stripe) and cycles land in the agent's wallet — the sovereign refuel path when the free faucet grant or deploy pool is exhausted.

tools.name: get_swap_quote
tools.description: Get a live, read-only swap quote on ICPSwap (the deepest on-chain DEX on ICP): how much receive_token you would get for pay_amount of pay_token. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_wallet" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
